items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Frank Melrose? Well, no, I think it was Walter Melrose.

ctx.x: Sure it is, entirely. But on the inside, worse yet, on the record, he says, he gave the name and then he said, Seitz, John Seitz, the other Seitz, King Oliver, Melrose, he named about four people and then Morton.
Frank Melrose? Well, no, I think it was Walter Melrose.

Walter Melrose. No, I think it was Walter, yeah, Walter Melrose. The publisher. He never wrote anything. No, four people had their names there. And on that instrumental thing, while Jelly Roll was the only one, he wrote it five years before Seitz brothers ever saw it. Spikes, Spikes, Spikes. Yeah, Spikes. Spikes, Spikes. Yeah, Spikes. Spikes.
